name: Carpet Tech
headline: A multi-location web platform growing inbound leads 10 to 15% a month
overview: Carpet Tech is a multi-location home services and restoration company operating across Texas and New Mexico. Techlio redesigned and rebuilt its full web presence as a lead-generation platform serving more than ten city locations.

challenges.title: Fragmented multi-location presence
challenges.text: Service areas had no dedicated local pages, so high-intent local searches went to a generic homepage.

challenges.title: Poor lead conversion
challenges.text: No structured lead forms, click-to-call or service-specific quote flows.

challenges.title: Outdated brand
challenges.text: The site did not reflect a four-division operation.

challenges.title: No emergency pathways
challenges.text: Water and fire restoration customers had no prominent urgent contact route.

solutions.title: Multi-location SEO architecture
solutions.text: Dedicated city and service pages for Lubbock, Amarillo, Odessa, Midland, McKinney, Frisco, Plano, Clovis and more.

solutions.title: Lead generation system
solutions.text: Structured quote forms, click-to-call and service-specific calls to action connected to the CRM.

solutions.title: Four-division visual system
solutions.text: A refreshed brand covering Carpet Tech, CT Restoration, CT Specialty Flooring and CT Indoor Air Quality.

solutions.title: Emergency response UX
solutions.text: Prominent 24/7 contact pathways and restoration-specific landing pages.

results: 10 to 15% month-over-month growth in inbound leads
10+ city-specific landing pages live with local SEO
Four-division brand architecture unified across the site
Click-to-call and quote forms on every service and location page
architecture: The site combines WordPress and React with Node.js services, connected to the Google Ads API and the client's CRM for lead handling. n8n automations and an Apache Airflow, dbt and Snowflake reporting pipeline sit behind the lead system.
